title: The Squeaky Saloon
moral: Even small help can make a big difference.

scenes.summary: Sheriff Sam lives in a town with a squeaky saloon door.
scenes.text: In Sunny Creek the saloon door squeaked loudly every time it opened.
scenes.image_prompt: cowboy sheriff standing near squeaky door in town, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: In the town of Sunny Creek there was a saloon with a squeaky door. Sheriff Sam was kind and brave. He wanted to fix the noisy door. He walked around town looking for oil but could not find any. Then he met Farmer Joe who had some oil. Farmer Joe gave it to him kindly. Sheriff Sam went back and oiled the door. The door became quiet. Everyone cheered and thanked him. Sheriff Sam smiled and said he was just doing his job. The town became peaceful and happy again.
